column2: [intro]
Sometimes I’ve got no view, lost in my life’s hue,
Between yes and no, I spin around, it’s nothing new.
I’m like a penguin on ice, all frozen and cold,
But that’s okay, we’ll dance, have fun, be bold.
I’ve got no opinion, I’m here just to cheer,
Dance all night long, nothing’s gonna bring me fear.
I’ve got no opinion, just here for the play,
Let’s leave our troubles behind and enjoy the day.

Hawaiian or four cheese, I just want to be set.
And when it’s time to pick a movie to view,
